pitch:
# A kanban board for a small team

## 1. People and their journey
**Team member** (the only role). Needs to see what work exists, its stage, and who is doing it. Decides what to create, assign and move. Path: open the board, scan columns, add or open a card, assign it, drag it onward until it reaches the last column.

## 2. How it looks
A kanban board as people know it from Trello: a pale grey-blue page, with tall rounded columns side by side, each holding a vertical stack of white cards.

- **Page background**: flat light blue-grey (#E9EEF4), fills the screen behind everything.
- **Top bar**: flat white strip across the top, thin grey bottom line, showing the board name at left and the member picker with the signed-in member's initials circle at right.
- **Board area**: horizontal row of columns on the background; scrolls sideways when columns overflow.
- **Column**: rounded flat light-grey (#DDE3EA) panel, fixed width. Shows header, card stack, and add-card button. While a card is dragged over it, its fill darkens to #CBD5E1 with a blue outline.
- **Column header**: bold dark-slate name at the top of a column, with the card count in a small grey pill. Name becomes an editable text box when clicked.
- **Column menu button**: three dots at header right; grey, darkens on hover. Opens rename, move left, move right, delete.
- **Card**: raised white rectangle, soft shadow, rounded corners, title in dark slate, a one-line description preview in grey when a description exists, assignee initials circle at bottom right. Hovered: shadow deepens. Being dragged: tilted slightly, stronger shadow, and its original spot shows a dashed empty outline.
- **Assignee circle**: round, filled with a colour fixed per member: blue, green, orange, purple, teal, red, in order of joining. An unassigned card shows a dashed grey empty circle.
- **Add-card button**: flat text button at the foot of a column, "+ Add a card", grey, with a pale fill on hover. Pressed, it becomes a title box with "Add" and cancel buttons.
- **Add-column area**: a translucent white column-sized button after the last column, "+ Add column"; becomes a name box when clicked.
- **Card detail panel**: white panel centred over a dimmed dark overlay, with an editable title, a description box, an assignee dropdown, a column dropdown, and Delete (red text) and Close buttons.
- **Delete confirmation**: small white dialog over the overlay, with a red Delete button and a grey Cancel button.
- **Empty column**: shows only the add-card button.

## 3. How it is used
- Click "+ Add a card", type a title, press Enter or click Add: the card appears at the bottom of that column.
- Press Escape or the cancel button in the add box: it closes and nothing is created.
- Click a card: the detail panel opens.
- Edit the title or description in the panel: the change saves when the field loses focus.
- Choose a member in the assignee dropdown: the card shows their circle. Choosing "Unassigned" clears it.
- Choose a column in the panel's column dropdown: the card moves to the bottom of that column.
- Drag a card with the mouse, or long-press then drag with a finger, to a spot in any column: it drops there.
- Click the panel's Delete: the confirmation appears; confirming removes the card.
- Click a column name: type a new name, press Enter to save, Escape to cancel.
- Use the column menu to move a column left or right, or delete it after confirming.
- Click "+ Add column", type a name, press Enter: the column is added at the end.
- Click outside the panel, or Close: it closes.

## 4. Scope
One board for the team. A member creates columns, adds cards, describes and assigns them, and moves them across columns until done. Nothing outside the board is included.

## 5. Things and their states
- **Board**: name, ordered columns. Always exists.
- **Column**: name, position. Exists until deleted.
- **Card**: title, description, assignee (optional), column, position. Moves between columns; exists until deleted.
- **Member**: name, colour. Can be assigned to any number of cards.

## 6. Rules
- A card title is required; an empty title is refused and the box stays open.
- A column name is required; an empty name reverts to the previous one.
- Titles are limited to 120 characters; extra typing is ignored.
- A card has at most one assignee.
- A card is in exactly one column at a time.
- Dropping a card outside any column returns it to its original place.
- Moving a card within a column reorders it; other cards shift to fit.
- Deleting a column that holds cards requires confirmation stating the card count; cancelling changes nothing.
- Deleting a column deletes its cards.
- The last remaining column cannot be deleted; the option is greyed out.
- Moving the first column left or the last right is unavailable.
- Deleting a card needs confirmation.
- Deleting a member is not offered; assignment is chosen only from existing members.
- Column names may repeat.

entities_block:
- **Board** (created by audience): [id: string, name: string, columns: list of Column {id: string, name: string, position: int}]
- **Member**: [id: string, name: string, colour: string, cards: list of Card {id: string, title: string, description: string, position: int, column_id: string}]
action_protocol_block:
The rules the product enforces (plan the audience's side of them; the business's own back-office handling is out of view):
- [Card title is required] (Board): Given the add-card box is open in a column When the member submits an empty title Then the card is not created and the box remains open
- [Card title maximum length] (Board): Given a title box with 120 characters When the member types another character Then the extra character is ignored and the title stays at 120 characters
- [Add card appends to column bottom] (Board): Given a column with existing cards When the member adds a card with a valid title and presses Enter Then the card appears at the last position of that column
- [Cancel add-card creates nothing] (Board): Given the add-card box is open with typed text When the member presses Escape or Cancel Then the box closes and no card is created
- [Card edits save on focus loss] (Board): Given a card detail panel with an edited title When the field loses focus Then the new title is saved to the card
- [Card has at most one assignee] (Board): Given a card assigned to member A When the member chooses member B in the assignee dropdown Then the card's assignee is B only
- [Unassigning a card] (Board): Given a card assigned to a member When the member chooses Unassigned Then the card has no assignee and the member still exists
- [Assignment restricted to existing members] (Member): Given the assignee dropdown is open When the member views options Then only existing members and Unassigned are offered
- [Card in exactly one column] (Board): Given a card in column A When the card is moved to column B Then the card is no longer in column A and is in column B only
- [Move card via column dropdown] (Board): Given a card in column A When the member chooses column B in the column dropdown Then the card moves to the last position in column B
- [Drag card to a position in a column] (Board): Given a card and a target column with cards When the member drags the card to a spot between two cards Then the card is inserted at that position in the target column
- [Reorder within a column shifts others] (Board): Given a column with cards at positions 1,2,3 When card at position 1 is moved to position 3 Then the cards occupy positions 1,2,3 in the new order with no gaps or duplicates
- [Drop outside any column reverts] (Board): Given a card being dragged When the card is released outside any column Then the card returns to its original column and position
- [Delete card requires confirmation] (Board): Given a card detail panel When the member clicks Delete and confirms Then the card is removed; if cancelled the card remains unchanged
- [Column name is required] (Board): Given a column name being edited When the member saves an empty name Then the column keeps its previous name
- [Column rename cancel] (Board): Given a column name being edited When the member presses Escape Then the name remains unchanged
- [Column names may repeat] (Board): Given a board with a column named Done When the member creates or renames another column to Done Then the rename or creation succeeds
- [Add column appends at end] (Board): Given a board with columns When the member enters a name and presses Enter on Add column Then a new column is appended as the last column
- [Move column left or right] (Board): Given the first column When the member opens the column menu Then Move left is unavailable and Move right swaps it with the second column
- [Delete column with cards requires confirmation] (Board): Given a column with 3 cards When the member chooses Delete and sees the confirmation Then the confirmation states 3 cards and cancelling leaves the column and cards intact
- [Deleting column deletes its cards] (Board): Given a column holding cards When the deletion is confirmed Then the column and all its cards are removed
- [Last column cannot be deleted] (Board): Given a board with exactly one column When the member opens the column menu Then Delete is unavailable
- [Columns keep contiguous positions] (Board): Given columns at positions 1 to 3 When the middle column is deleted Then the remaining columns occupy positions 1 and 2
- [Empty column shows only add-card button] (Board): Given a column with no cards When the board is displayed Then only the add-card button is shown in that column
- [Dismiss card panel without changes] (Board): Given the card detail panel is open When the member clicks outside the panel or Close Then the panel closes
- [Board persistence of cards and columns] (Board): Given a card moved to another column When the member reloads the board Then the card remains in the new column at its position
intent_block:
- Product type: internal_tool
- Audience: members of a small team tracking their shared work
- Goal: Let the team see what work exists, what stage each item is in, and who is doing it, by moving cards across columns on a board.
- Scope: A single kanban board per team, made of ordered columns containing cards that team members create, edit, assign, and move between columns.
- The model must cover: boards and their ordered columns (workflow stages); cards representing work items, with title and description; team members and card assignment; card position and movement between columns
- Do NOT model: customer or external user access; billing or subscription management; reporting or analytics dashboards; integrations with other tools
